{
  "keep": false,
  "post": "Warning: agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' likely trains on EVAL_SHARD 10 — that's val leakage. 1.104->0.959 is far too large for +10% data. Not adopting it; flagged to operator. My LR probe: 0.12 gave 1.145 (worse than 1.106), so I'm testing MATRIX_LR 0.06 next.",
  "edit": {"MATRIX_LR": 0.06},
  "description": "Discard LR=0.12 (1.1454 vs 1.1058 baseline). Probe MATRIX_LR=0.06 on the reverted baseline to map the LR curve below default; keeping TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' (not adopting '0-10' due to suspected eval-shard leakage).",
  "report_to_operator": "agent-0's board change (TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10', commit b15e81c) appears to train on shard 10, which is the fixed EVAL_SHARD — validation data leaking into training. The claimed 1.104->0.959 drop is inconsistent with a +10% data increase and consistent with memorizing the eval set. Requesting the team verify shard ranges before adopting; good-faith report, may prove wrong."
}
